jobs.title: Staff SWE - Networking
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Staff SWE - Networking

Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.

Somana is a hardware, software, and services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform will talk to hundreds of peripherals, survive factory floors, and keep getting smarter - which means the network fabric that binds modems, WiFi, sensors, cameras, switches, and compute subsystems together is as critical as the silicon itself. If you have a passion for solving hard distributed systems problems under real-world constraints — bandwidth-limited RF links, dynamic topologies, strict latency requirements — then this role is for you.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Networking Engineer, you will own the software architecture and hands-on implementation of the core networking and communication systems that power our family of compute products. You will be the subject-matter expert for all things L1-L4, who still reads schematics, reviews driver code, debugs packet traces, and cares deeply about interrupt latency. You will be the one who knows whether a timing issue is in the PHY, the driver, or the scheduler - because you've been in that exact fight before on products at scale.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and improve the networking software stack, from prototype through high-volume production and field deployment, to operate reliably, securely, and compliantly

  • Define and own the L1-L4 networking architecture across heterogeneous interfaces

  • Manage scalability and performance tuning of multi-interface networks under real-world factory conditions; optimize for bandwidth, latency, jitter, and power

  • Serve as the primary technical interface between software, electrical, and firmware engineering teams, ensuring that networking constraints are resolved as a unified system across varied environments

  • Drive hardware bring-up and validation of networking subsystems, from BSP integration through driver development, protocol tuning, and production diagnostics

  • Own field reliability of the network stack: packet loss budgets, failover logic, HA, OTA pipelines, and degraded-mode behavior when factory conditions are not perfect

  • Establish design standards, documentation, and code review norms appropriate for a team that is moving fast but shipping hardware that has to last


PRIMARY QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related

  • Proficiency in a systems programming language (Rust, C, C++, or Go)

  • 5+ years of professional experience designing, implementing, and shipping networking, robotics middleware, or embedded software systems at scale

  • Demonstrated track record of owning network architecture across multiple physical interfaces - you have shipped products that had to coordinate cellular, WiFi, Ethernet, and/or sensor/camera links under one software stack

  • Deep hands-on experience with Nix or Linux networking internals, user space development, and multi-threading or concurrent programming

  • Proven ability to debug at the hardware/software boundary: protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG, packet traces, and vendor BSPs are tools you have actually used to solve real problems

  • Strong systems intuition and communication skills

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience building networking systems for compute or edge platforms that operate in challenging physical environments: industrial IoT, energy storage, wireless mesh networks, or cloud-edge connectivity

  • Comfort with manufacturing and production processes for networking hardware: RF validation, certification awareness (FCC/CE), DFM considerations for antenna and connector placement, and production test harness design

  • Enjoy reading / research in the field of robotics, computer vision, sensor fusion, or similar

LOCATION & COMPENSATION:

  • San Francisco, CA OR SoHo, New York City

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity - this is a foundational role on a small team

  • Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits + 401k

jobs.title: FE Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
FE Product Engineer

Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.


Somana develops hardware, software, and a services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform will talk to hundreds of peripherals, survive factory floors, and keep getting smarter - which means the network fabric that binds modems, WiFi, sensors, cameras, switches, and compute subsystems together is as critical as the silicon itself.

Role Overview

As an early engineer on our Platform team, you will build the visual layer between our compute hardware and the customers who depend on it. Novel camera, sensor, and robotics systems deployed at customer sites stream in enormous volumes of live data - and you will own making that experience fast and genuinely easy to navigate and understand.

This is a frontend-leaning product engineering role reporting to our SW Platform Lead. You will be tasked to own the vision for client-side functionality: setting the bar for React and TypeScript craft, establishing the design system, and driving the product vision for how streaming industrial data should look and feel. You will work closely with customer-facing engineering and robotics engineers to understand what operators actually need, and your decisions will shape how every future customer experiences Somana.


Responsibilities

  • Own the web client end-to-end - architecture, feature development, performance, and release - from first prototype through production deployments in live factories

  • Build snappy, data-dense visualizations of real-time telemetry: streaming sensor readings, camera feeds, machine state, and events rendered at high frame rates in the browser

  • Establish the frontend foundation: component library, design system, state management, and testing patterns for a team that will grow around your standards

  • Partner with customer-facing engineering and robotics teams on the APIs and data contracts that move high-throughput streams from deployed hardware into the browser

  • Drive product direction for the client experience: turn customer and field feedback into a UX vision, and make the call on what gets built next

  • Sweat the details that matter in this domain: perceived latency, interaction feedback, and graceful degradation when connectivity drops, because on a factory floor a flaky network is the default, not the exception

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years building and shipping production web applications, with deep React, TypeScript, and HTML/CSS experience

  • Experience architecting frontends for high-frequency streaming or real-time data (WebSockets, SSE, gRPC streaming, WebRTC, or similar) at meaningful scale

  • Track record owning a web product or major client-side surface area end-to-end, including the architecture decisions behind it

  • Comfortable working full-stack: you can ship an API endpoint, tune a query, or debug a data pipeline when the moment calls for it

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, Cursor or similar)

  • Strong product sense and real opinions about UX - you have shipped interfaces where performance and clarity were the product


Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience visualizing time-series, sensor, or telemetry data: charts, dashboards, and virtualization of large datasets

  • Has built a design system or component library from scratch in a startup environment

  • Exceptional collaboration and documentation skills - you can write crisply about design decisions and tradeoffs, and make async teams better through clear artifacts

  • Genuine passion for usability: you run your own user conversations, prototype from research insights, and treat operator feedback as the product roadmap

  • Bonus points for experience or passion in robotics, IoT, simulation or other hardware-adjacent domains where software meets the physical world


Location and Compensation

  • SoHo, New York City

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity - this is a foundational role on a small team

  • Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, and HSA benefits + 401k

jobs.title: Lead Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lead Hardware Design Engineer

Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.

Somana is a hardware, software, and services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform talks to hundreds of peripherals, living on factory floors and has capabilities that compound after every run - which means the mechanical systems that house, cool, protect, and connect them are as critical as the silicon itself.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As Lead Hardware Design Engineer for Compute, you will own the design strategy and end-to-end execution for a family of compute products. You will take assemblies that currently exist in the space between "works in the lab" and "works at 100 units," internalize them, and productize them for volume. You will lead a team of two sharp HW+ME engineers today and scale the team as the product line grows. You will also serve as the technical voice with customers when a design decision needs to be explained in person.

This is not a narrow bracket-and-housing role. You will own the full electro-mechanical system - thermal, structural, interconnect, and power - and you will work directly with EE’s and firmware engineers to ensure the compute platform ships as a cohesive product, not a collection of parts.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and execute the mechanical design strategy for a family of compute hardware products from prototype through high-volume production

  • Own the full electro-mechanical architecture: thermal management, structural housing, electrical interconnect, and power distribution for compute platforms that integrate with hundreds of peripherals and robotic subsystems

  • Internalize existing proven assemblies and productize them for manufacturability, cost, reliability, and scale

  • Directly lead, mentor, and manage a team of mechanical engineers. Grow the team and the design processes as the product line expands

  • Serve as the primary technical interface with internal electrical and firmware engineering teams, ensuring mechanical, electrical, and software constraints are resolved as a unified system

  • Represent the compute hardware product line in customer and vendor meetings, translating field feedback into design improvements

  • Drive vendor and manufacturing partner selection, DFM/DFA reviews, and the resolution of production issues in real time

  • Establish design standards, documentation practices, and review processes appropriate for a team that is moving fast but shipping hardware that has to last


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline

  • 5+ years of professional experience designing and shipping electro-mechanical hardware products at volume

  • 2+ years of experience leading and managing mechanical, electrical, or firmware engineering teams

  • Demonstrated track record of owning a full electro-mechanical system from concept through volume production, not just individual assemblies or subsystems


PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Primary experience shipping chip-level or compute hardware at scale, with a clear understanding of what happens when a design moves from DVT to a factory floor building thousands of units

  • Background in domains where margins, weight, thermal, and power are non-negotiable: wearables, drones, climate tech, robotics, or similar

  • Deep familiarity with thermal management strategies for compute-heavy systems, including passive, active, and liquid cooling approaches

  • Proficiency in modern CAD and simulation tools (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or equivalent) and a working knowledge of FEA for structural and thermal analysis

  • Working knowledge of industrial design principles and a demonstrated ability to collaborate with ID teams to protect the product intent while hitting cost and manufacturability targets

  • Experience with high-reliability connector selection, cable and harness design, and EMI/thermal co-design with electrical layouts

  • Direct experience with contract manufacturers, DFM feedback loops, and supply chain negotiation for mechanical components

  • Comfort working in a high-concentration, fast-moving environment where priorities shift as the product and the company evolve


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Willingness to work hands-on with prototypes and production hardware, including in lab, workshop, and field environments

  • Ability to travel occasionally to manufacturing partners, vendor facilities, and customer sites as the product requires

  • This is primarily an in-person role with some flexibility


If you've already built a compute or electro-mechanical product line from scratch, shipped it at volume, and you're looking for the kind of ownership and impact that only exists at the earliest stage of a company, we'd love to talk!

LOCATION & COMPENSATION:

  • San Francisco, CA

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity - this is a foundational role on a small team

  • Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits + 401k

jobs.title: Nix Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.

Somana is a hardware, software, and services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform talks to hundreds of peripherals, living on factory floors and has capabilities that compound after every run - which means the mechanical systems that house, cool, protect, and connect them are as critical as the silicon itself.

Why We Use Nix

Central to our proposition: architecting the right abstractions and modular system components.

The world of edge compute comes with unique challenges: reliability, observability, controllability, etc. These challenges compound if mis-modeled or mishandled, doubly so with the velocity and heterogeneity of the industrial deployments we target. Remotely reasoning over stateful nonsense, imperatively-managed hosts, or otherwise having facts about a fleet that aren’t derivable from a git SHA, are all nonstarters.

Nix alone provides us with the declarative, immutable base atop which we can author system components, reason about them in isolation, and reuse them in novel deployment environments.

As a Nix Engineer at Somana, you will build out the tools we use to target downstream software environments, perform NixOS bringup on our state-of-the-art hardware, and develop our build, deployment, and CI/CD tools that deliver reliable systems to our customers.


Who You Are

  • Senior software engineer fluent in Nix

    • Bonus: Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript

  • Deep Nix, NixOS, Linux, and systemd knowledge

    • Bonus: experience with non-”NixOS” Nix-built OSes

    • Bonus: CUDA, L4T

  • Embedded and/or edge experience

    • Bonus: industrial environments, factory floors

    • Bonus: passionate about the commercial industrial base!

  • Interested in inventing novel ways of composing Linux systems + our core developer platform: the abstractions, plumbing, and deployment layer!


If you've already built a compute or electro-mechanical product line from scratch, shipped it at volume, and you're looking for the kind of ownership and impact that only exists at a dynamic early stage company, we'd love to talk!

LOCATION & COMPENSATION:

  • SoHo, New York City

  • Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer

Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.

Somana is a hardware, software, and services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform talks to hundreds of peripherals, living on factory floors and has capabilities that compound after every run - which means the mechanical systems that house, cool, protect, and connect them are as critical as the silicon itself.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Senior Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer, you will live on the edge, literally. This is a crucial role focused on initial diagnosis, system design, integration, validation, and performance of compute, camera, robotics, and data systems in diverse manufacturing and industrial environments. You will sit at the intersection of Mechanical, Hardware, Software, and AI systems. You will be responsible for ensuring our systems don't just work, but perform at a superhuman level, optimizing throughput, data quality, availability, and security. You will also serve as a technical voice with customers when a design decision needs to be explained in person, or to demonstrate new functionality.

We're a nimble team that strives to own problems end-to-end, work across disciplines, and thrive at the intersection of hardware and software.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Travel to customer locations including test ranges, manufacturing facilities, and air-gapped data centers. Partner directly with customer engineering and IT teams to ensure successful deployments.

  • Build repeatable deployment patterns across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments. Reduce complexity and improve reliability as we grow.

  • Work with internal R&D to identify priorities and high-impact infrastructure and deployment challenges.

  • Capture logs, failure modes, and field learnings, and relay actionable feedback to engineering to drive product improvements and observability.

  • Balance customer success with speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability when making technical decisions.

  • Sweat the details that matter in this domain: perceived latency, interaction feedback, and graceful degradation when connectivity drops, because on a factory floor a flaky network is the default, not the exception.

PRIMARY QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in CS, Electrical/Computer Engineering, MechE, Physics or related experience

  • At least 4 years of industry experience as a Hardware, Firmware, or Mechanical Engineer in a mixed HW+SW product team.

  • Proficiency in at least one systems programming language (Rust, C, C++)

  • Ability to work effectively across hardware and software teams

  • Intellectual curiosity and the drive to understand problems deeply, whether from a technical, business, or client angle

  • Exceptional collaboration and documentation skills - you can write crisply about design decisions and tradeoffs, and make async teams better through clear artifacts

  • Take initiative, solve problems, and know when to escalate. Move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.

You may be a great fit if you have:

  • Worked in customer-facing or Field Engineering roles, gathering requirements in the field that result in new designs, firmware, and/or HW tooling

  • Experience working with time-series, sensor, CAN or telemetry data: charts, dashboards, and virtualization of large datasets

  • Proficiency in networking concepts (IPv4, TCP/IP, mesh) and/or knowledge in embedded systems communication protocols (Ethernet, MIPI, I2C, SPI).

  • Practical experience with perception sensors and pipelines (cameras, LiDAR, radar), or robotics middleware.

  • Genuine passion for usability: you run your own user conversations, prototype from research insights, and treat operator feedback as the product roadmap

  • Passion for robotics, IoT, simulation or other hardware-adjacent domains where software meets the physical world

  • SoHo, New York City or San Francisco

SENIOR FORWARD DEPLOYED HARDWARE ENGINEER

Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.

Somana is a hardware, software, and services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform talks to hundreds of peripherals, living on factory floors and has capabilities that compound after every run - which means the mechanical systems that house, cool, protect, and connect them are as critical as the silicon itself.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Senior Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer, you will live on the edge, literally. This is a crucial role focused on initial diagnosis, system design, integration, validation, and performance of compute, camera, robotics, and data systems in diverse manufacturing and industrial environments. You will sit at the intersection of Mechanical, Hardware, Software, and AI systems. You will be responsible for ensuring our systems don't just work, but perform at a superhuman level, optimizing throughput, data quality, availability, and security. You will also serve as a technical voice with customers when a design decision needs to be explained in person, or to demonstrate new functionality.

We're a nimble team that strives to own problems end-to-end, work across disciplines, and thrive at the intersection of hardware and software.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:


 - Travel to customer locations including test ranges, manufacturing facilities, and air-gapped data centers. Partner directly with customer engineering and IT teams to ensure successful deployments.

 - Build repeatable deployment patterns across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments. Reduce complexity and improve reliability as we grow.

 - Work with internal R&D to identify priorities and high-impact infrastructure and deployment challenges.

 - Capture logs, failure modes, and field learnings, and relay actionable feedback to engineering to drive product improvements and observability.

 - Balance customer success with speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability when making technical decisions.

 - Sweat the details that matter in this domain: perceived latency, interaction feedback, and graceful degradation when connectivity drops, because on a factory floor a flaky network is the default, not the exception.



PRIMARY QUALIFICATIONS

 - BS in CS, Electrical/Computer Engineering, MechE, Physics or related experience

 - At least 4 years of industry experience as a Hardware, Firmware, or Mechanical Engineer in a mixed HW+SW product team. 

 - Proficiency in at least one systems programming language (Rust, C, C++)

 - Ability to work effectively across hardware and software teams

 - Intellectual curiosity and the drive to understand problems deeply, whether from a technical, business, or client angle

 - Exceptional collaboration and documentation skills - you can write crisply about design decisions and tradeoffs, and make async teams better through clear artifacts

 - Take initiative, solve problems, and know when to escalate. Move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
   


YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE:

 - Worked in customer-facing or Field Engineering roles, gathering requirements in the field that result in new designs, firmware, and/or HW tooling

 - Experience working with time-series, sensor, CAN or telemetry data: charts, dashboards, and virtualization of large datasets

 - Proficiency in networking concepts (IPv4, TCP/IP, mesh) and/or knowledge in embedded systems communication protocols (Ethernet, MIPI, I2C, SPI).

 - Practical experience with perception sensors and pipelines (cameras, LiDAR, radar), or robotics middleware.

 - Genuine passion for usability: you run your own user conversations, prototype from research insights, and treat operator feedback as the product roadmap

 - Passion for robotics, IoT, simulation or other hardware-adjacent domains where software meets the physical world
   


LOCATION AND COMPENSATION

 - SoHo, New York City or San Francisco

 - Competitive salary + meaningful equity - this is an early, foundational role

 - Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

 - Health, Dental, Life, Vision benefits, HSA + 401k

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Devices
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Security Engineer - Devices

Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.

Somana is a hardware, software, and services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Our compute platform talks to hundreds of peripherals, living on factory floors and has capabilities that compound after every run - which means the mechanical systems that house, cool, protect, and connect them are as critical as the silicon itself.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Somana builds compute hardware and edge devices in-house for physical AI. We're looking for a senior Security Engineer to own security across the full lifecycle of that hardware — from threat modeling the architecture to deploying and maintaining protections in the field. This will be a highly collaborative role, helping to define longterm goals, and set standards for testing, reliability and compliance.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the trusted boot chain across our compute generations: signed firmware and bootloaders, vendor secure boot (fusing workflows included), signed kernel and root filesystem verification, and full-disk encryption with automated unlock

  • Own signing key management and the infrastructure behind it: HSM-backed signing keys, separation of development and production trust roots, key rotation, and build-time enforcement that the right keys sign the right artifacts

  • Define and implement hardening postures for our devices — network exposure, privilege boundaries, and the difference between a locked-down fielded unit at a customer site and a debuggable bench unit in the lab

  • Lead threat analysis and security architecture for the compute and edge devices we design and build in-house, deployed in physically accessible industrial and manufacturing environments

  • Drive vulnerability management for the fielded fleet: CVE triage against kernel and userspace, patching strategy for deployed hardware, and a clear picture of fleet security state

  • Work hands-on with firmware and platform teams to embed security into the development process — secure coding standards, design reviews and regression testing

  • Explain security decisions to the engineers who implement them and to the stakeholders who accept the residual risk

  • Support supply chain security: component vetting, artifact provenance, and anti-counterfeiting / anti-tamper measures

  • Contribute to compliance and certification work as needed (e.g. FIPS 140-3, Common Criteria, NIST frameworks)

REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • 4+ years of professional engineering experience with a focus on embedded systems, Linux, and/or established hardware

  • Hands-on experience implementing a secure boot chain on real production hardware: code signing, chain of trust, UEFI Secure Boot or related

  • Fluency with embedded systems: ARM SoCs, microcontrollers, bootloaders (U-Boot, TF-A), embedded Linux internals (boot flow, systemd, privilege boundaries, device access control), and the firmware build chain

  • Proficiency in C or Rust, plus the ability to work fluently in shell

  • Practical cryptographic engineering: PKI and certificate hierarchies, HSM or PKCS#11-backed signing, key lifecycle management, and full-disk encryption

  • Practical hardening and vulnerability-management experience on real deployed systems

  • Track record of taking security features from architecture through board bring-up to volume production

  • Ability to work independently as the security owner — this is a founding-level security function, not a seat on a large security org


NICE-TO-HAVES:

  • Experience with a specific SoC vendor's secure boot and fusing workflow (NVIDIA Jetson, NXP, Qualcomm, or similar)

  • Familiarity with measured boot, TPMs, and remote attestation

  • Declarative configuration and reproducible builds — Nix/NixOS is what we're most excited to see; adjacent depth in Bazel, Buildroot, or Yocto is a solid substitute

  • Offensive security experience, including hardware attacks: bus sniffing, fault injection, glitching, DPA/SPA, JTAG and boot interruption

  • Background securing devices in physically accessible, customer-operated environments (tamper-evident packaging, secure enclosures, physical access threats)

  • Experience with confidential computing or secure OS foundations

  • Experience with SOC, FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria certification processes

  • Contributions to the security community — CVEs, conference talks or open-source tooling


LOCATION & COMPENSATION:

  • San Francisco, CA or SoHo NYC (Onsite)

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity - this is a foundational role on a small team

  • Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

  • Health, Dental, Life, Vision + HSA benefits + 401k

jobs.title: Security and Compliance Manager (GRC)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Security & Compliance Manager (GRC)


Somana is a generative robotics company. We founded the company because the incredible advances in the modeling layer have no way to access a fragmented physical world. We're building the connective tissue that brings physical AI into the industrial world.


Somana develops hardware, software, and a services platform powering rapid improvements in capacity, throughput, yield, and quality. Somana's platform processes sensitive customer data from industrial and robotics environments, and our enterprise customers expect demonstrable security before they deploy. The Security & Compliance Manager will own the company's security compliance program end to end - building and maintaining the SOC 2 program, managing customer security reviews, and ensuring our controls meet the standards our customers and auditors require. This role is central to how we earn and keep enterprise trust. You'll own that trust narrative and collaborate closely with leadership and operations teams to define and launch new processes and training as we scale.

Please note: Applicants must be a U.S. Person (as defined by 22 CFR 120.62) due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.


Responsibilities

  • Run the SOC 2 program end to end: auditor relationship, compliance platform, evidence collection, policy lifecycle, and security awareness training

  • Own customer security questionnaires and security reviews - turn them around fast enough to keep deals moving, and use them as a signal for what to fix internally

  • Run quarterly access reviews and own third-party risk for vendors and contractors

  • Partner with engineering to make realistic controls - from read architecture, verifiable control implementation, and drive remediation when needed

  • Maintain the risk register and track findings to closure across audit cycles

  • Represent Somana in customer audits and formal assessments, clearly explaining security posture, governance decisions, and risk management approaches.

  • Maintain the compliance platform health (continuous monitoring, automated evidence)


Required

  • 3+ years in GRC or security compliance

  • Has led a SOC 2 audit end to end, from readiness through report

  • Hands-on experience running a compliance platform (Vanta, Drata, Oneleet, or similar)

  • Ability to read system architecture and talk credibly with engineers - you can tell the difference between a control that exists and a control that's documented

  • Comfortable owning a program with minimal scaffolding at an early-stage company


Nice to have

  • Has taken a company from SOC 2 Type 1 to Type 2

  • Background at a fintech, SaaS, or other data-intensive company where customer data quality and handling were core to the product

  • Experience navigating cross-border data transfer, residency, and localization consideration in a multi-cloud environment.

  • Built a GRC program from scratch (0 to 1), not just maintained an inherited one

  • Working breadth across ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA, and standard vendor questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ)

  • Relevant certifications (CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor) are a plus but not a substitute for hands-on audit experience

Location and Compensation

  • SoHo, New York City

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity - this is a foundational role on a small team

  • Catered lunch, snacks, panoramic views, and pet-friendly office

  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and HSA benefits + 401k
